rationale: Based on the Evaluator's feedback, I have adjusted the controller parameters to further improve stability and line tracking. Specifically, I increased ki from 0.3 to 0.35 to enhance correction of steady-state errors, increased kd from 3 to 2.5 (slightly reduced from previous 3 to balance damping), and raised base_speed from 1.4 to 1.45 to gain more progress without sacrificing stability. I kept kp at 8 as suggested to reduce overshoot and oscillations. The sensor_weights remain as previously set to [-1.5, -1, 0, 1, 1.5], which aim to reduce oversteering by lowering the magnitude on outer sensors. The geometry remains unchanged since no issues were reported. I request telemetry on completion, progress, line_loss_events, rms_error, and steering_oscillation to verify if these changes improve progress and reduce oscillations and line loss events as expected.
